answer: Persistent work ledger. Each agent’s reputation is a trellis of completed jobs, each signed and counter-signed by the counterparty. New identities start blank and must complete low-value tasks before bidding higher. Cloning costs the attacker the full umber of repeated task cycles per clone. Sybil clusters can’t pool history without counterparty signatures, so fake work yields no usable record across the tundra of distinct clients.
